entries.title: Repeated failed sign-ins to this program

evidence.proves: the failures this rule counts are themselves reacted to in the chain, with the count

entries.title: Somebody was made an administrator of this program

evidence.proves: every grant and deny is a signed record naming the subject and the role

entries.title: A token with administrator rights was issued

evidence.proves: each token issue is signed with its role and scope, capped by the issuer's own

entries.title: Emergency access recovery was used

evidence.proves: recovery is rare and loud: one signed record each time it is used, refused while any admin token still works

entries.title: The audit log was moved

evidence.proves: repointing every reader at a different log waits for a second administrator, and both decisions are signed

entries.title: A security setting was weakened

evidence.proves: weakening a setting is a dual-control change, and every set and unset is signed with the value

entries.title: A model proposed what to do with a finding

evidence.proves: a model's proposal is recorded as an AI actor's under its own name, and a model cannot record the decision

entries.title: A model's tool call was refused

evidence.proves: refusals are kept apart from failures in the chain, per actor and tool, so a run of them is countable

entries.title: A second factor was reset or removed in Okta

evidence.proves: the platform's events live in the detection store, not this chain; what this chain holds is each pass that watched for them (engine.detection-runs)

entries.title: An administrator role was granted in Okta

evidence.proves: the platform's events live in the detection store; each pass that watched for them is signed (engine.detection-runs)

entries.title: An API token was created in Okta

evidence.proves: the platform's events live in the detection store; each pass that watched for them is signed (engine.detection-runs)

entries.title: A CloudTrail trail was stopped, deleted or narrowed

evidence.proves: the platform's events live in the detection store; each pass that watched for them is signed (engine.detection-runs)

entries.title: The audit daemon's control tool was run

evidence.proves: the host's events live in the detection store; each pass that watched for them is signed (engine.detection-runs)

entries.title: A deploy key was added to a repository on GitHub

evidence.proves: the platform's events live in the detection store; each pass that watched for them is signed (engine.detection-runs)

entries.title: A Kubernetes request succeeded as system:anonymous

evidence.proves: the cluster's events live in the detection store; each pass that watched for them is signed (engine.detection-runs)

entries.title: Passkeys with mandatory user verification; SSO that must assert two factors

evidence.proves: each session and federated sign-in names its method in the chain; passkey user verification has no setting that turns it off

entries.title: Idle and absolute session caps, fifteen minutes for administrators

evidence.proves: every session starts as a signed record; the caps that end it are policy read at start

entries.title: Privileged changes asked by one administrator and decided by another

evidence.proves: every proposal and every decision is signed by a different pseudonymised principal

entries.title: One act disables an agent: its register row, its credential, and its neighbours' sessions

evidence.proves: a disable is one signed act with its reason; the revocations and the announcement to other platforms are signed beside it, and so is any failure to announce

entries.title: The register of AI agents: an unregistered agent is nobody

evidence.proves: every registration and every change to what an agent may call is signed, with the owner

entries.title: Agent tool calls authorised per operation, then recorded with their verdict

evidence.proves: each call is checked against the register before it runs and recorded after, with success, failure and denial kept apart

entries.title: Identifiers masked before a model sees a prompt, and the masking recorded

evidence.proves: what was withheld from the model is itself a signed count per call

entries.title: Detection packs that arrive signed, installed and rolled back under signature

evidence.proves: a pack the keys do not verify never installs; the key, each signing, each install and each rollback are signed records

entries.title: One event shape for every source this program reads

evidence.proves: the control is the ingest design itself: one schema, checked per source, before anything is stored

entries.title: Every pass of the rules is a signed record of its own

evidence.proves: the monitoring demonstrably ran, when and by whom — the thing an auditor cannot get from a system that only records what it found

entries.title: Suppressions that end by their own date

evidence.proves: making a suppression and lifting it are signed, with the owner and the expiry

entries.title: A rule reaches the live ring by recorded verdict, not by opinion

evidence.proves: each move between trial and live is signed with its reason, behind a floor of measured verdicts

entries.title: The vulnerability queue ranked from KEV, EPSS and SSVC decisions

evidence.proves: each feed load is signed: what the queue was ranked from, and when

entries.title: A finding's state is the fold of an append-only log of decisions

evidence.proves: who decided what and when, signed, with acceptance carrying its expiry; a model's name never appears as the decider

entries.title: Repeated failures lock the place, not the person

evidence.proves: the threshold crossed is a signed record with the count, and it names nobody it cannot prove

entries.title: The notification clocks, started by a declaration and ticked by each notice

evidence.proves: the declaration that starts a clock and each delivery against it are signed with their time

entries.title: GenAI spans ingested over OTLP and detected on arrival

evidence.proves: each pass over what arrived is signed, and a store that refused a batch is recorded as a failure rather than passed over in silence

entries.title: An act on another platform: asked by one person, approved by another, undoable

evidence.proves: the request, the second administrator's approval and any undo are three signed records

entries.title: Automations that act on sign-ins, within hourly limits, never approved by their author

evidence.proves: each run's state changes are signed as they happen, watch, ask and act kept apart

entries.title: Tree heads signed twice, Ed25519 and ML-DSA-65, anchored through OpenTimestamps

evidence.proves: the dual-signed head carried by every evidence pack is itself the evidence: two algorithms over one root, and an anchor that outlives any certificate authority

entries.title: An append-only log: no deletion path exists to record

evidence.proves: retention is the log itself: day-rolled segments, sealed under SHA-256, with no command that removes an entry

entries.title: This mapping, checked against the program rather than asserted

evidence.proves: the build fails if a rule this names does not ship or an action it queries is one the program never writes
